title: from_h5ad_to_h5mu
description: Converts a single layer h5ad file into a single MuData object

input.help_text: type: `array`, multiple: True, required, default: `input.h5ad`, direction: `input`

modality.description:
List of names to use for the modalities. Will be used as the keys in the .mod attribute in the output MuData object
The number of items provided for this argument equal the number of input files (--input) and their order should match.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
